name: Banshee Realm 11
description: FFXI private server (LandSandBoat fork) running as a five-service docker compose stack: database (MariaDB), connect, search, world, map. Lua scripts and settings are live-mounted, so content changes only need a service restart. The stack survives reboots via restart policies + banshee.service.
buildCommand: docker build -f docker/ubuntu.Dockerfile --tag localhost/banshee-realm:latest --build-arg COMPILER=gcc --build-arg CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release --build-arg PCH_ENABLE=ON --build-arg REPO_URL=https://github.com/Blizz127/Banshee-Realm-11 --build-arg COMMIT_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD) .

launchProfile.updateCommand: git pull --ff-only && docker compose up -d --remove-orphans && docker compose restart connect search world map
launchProfile.metricsCommand: players=$(docker compose exec -T database sh -lc 'mariadb -N -u xiadmin -p"$MARIADB_PASSWORD" xidb -e "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM accounts_sessions"' 2>/dev/null || echo '?'); echo "Players: $players"; docker stats --no-stream --format '{{.Name}}\t{{.CPUPerc}}\t{{.MemUsage}}' | awk -F'\t' '$1 ~ /^banshee-realm-11/ {gsub(/%/,"",$2); cpu+=$2; split($3,m," / "); v=m[1]; if (v ~ /GiB/) {gsub(/GiB/,"",v); mem+=v*1024} else if (v ~ /MiB/) {gsub(/MiB/,"",v); mem+=v} else if (v ~ /KiB/) {gsub(/KiB/,"",v); mem+=v/1024}} END {printf "CPU: %.0f%%\nRAM: %.1f GB\n", cpu, mem/1024}'
